## Load Packages

```{r}
#| message: false

#install.packages(inflateR)
#install.packages(jtools)

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(inflateR)
library(jtools)

options(scipen = 999)
```

## Load & Prep Data

```{r}
trail_benefit_data <- read_csv(here("trail_rec", "trail_benefit_data.csv")) |>
  clean_names() |>
  select(lead_author:dollar_year) |>
  drop_na(lead_author) |>
  rename(
    visitors_per_year = number_of_trail_users_per_year,
    miles_studied = total_trail_miles_or_miles_added,
    ben_per_person_trip_low = benefit_per_person_per_visit_trip_usd_low,
    ben_per_person_trip_high = benefit_per_visit_trip_usd_high,
    annual_agg_ben_low = total_benefit_annual_unless_noted_low,
    annual_agg_ben_high = total_benefit_annual_unless_noted_high,
    ben_per_mile_low = benefit_per_trail_mile_per_year_usd_low,
    ben_per_mile_high = benefit_per_trail_mile_per_year_usd_high) |>
  mutate(across(visitors_per_year:dollar_year, as.numeric))
    
```

## Pivot Data to be Tidy

*Finds high and low estimates for benefit (consumer surplus) per visitor.*

```{r}
trail_benefit_tidy <- trail_benefit_data |>
  select(lead_author:miles_studied, dollar_year, ben_per_person_trip_low, ben_per_person_trip_high) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = "ben_per_person_trip_low":"ben_per_person_trip_high",
               names_to = "low_high",
               values_to = "ben_per_visitor")
```

## Convert nominal dollar values to 2024 USD.

```{r}
trail_benefit_tidy <- trail_benefit_tidy |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    ben_per_visitor_2024 = adjust_inflation(
      amount    = ben_per_visitor,
      from_year = dollar_year,
      currency  = "USD",
      to_year   = 2024
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()
```

## Summary Statistics: Benefit per Visitor (assume 1 Visitor = 1 Trip)
```{r}
mean_ben <- mean(trail_benefit_tidy$ben_per_visitor_2024)
median_ben <- median(trail_benefit_tidy$ben_per_visitor_2024)
range(trail_benefit_tidy$ben_per_visitor_2024)
sd <- sd(trail_benefit_tidy$ben_per_visitor_2024)

#mean is approx equal to the SD... 

ggplot(data = trail_benefit_tidy, aes(x = ben_per_visitor_2024)) +
   geom_bar() +
  scale_x_binned()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean_ben, color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_ben, color = "green") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean_ben + sd, color = "purple") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean_ben - sd, color = "purple") +
  labs(
    x = "Benefit per Visitor Trip (2024 USD)",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

## Regression: Per-Mile Trail Benefit

```{r}
trail_ben_reg <- lm(ben_per_visitor_2024 ~ miles_studied + visitors_per_year,
                 data = trail_benefit_tidy
                 )
b <- coef(trail_ben_reg)

summary(trail_ben_reg, digits = 4)
```

## Create a Predictive Function

```{r}

# `ben_estimate` is the benefit per visitor for each trip

ben_estimate <- function(miles_studied, visitors_per_year) {
  b["(Intercept)"] + b["miles_studied"] * miles_studied + b["visitors_per_year"] * visitors_per_year
}

# SMRP-Specific Parameters
smrp_vis = 100000
smrp_mi = 2.21

# Calculate the estimated Benefit ($) in 
final_estimate_smrp <- (ben_estimate(miles_studied = smrp_mi, visitors_per_year = smrp_vis)) * smrp_vis

cat("The estimated benefit of the additional", smrp_mi, "miles of trail by the Santa Margarita River Bridge Project are $", final_estimate_smrp, "per year.")

```
